en.bdb: I worship and adore my Guru; the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.
My Guru is the Supreme Lord God; the Guru is the Lord God.
My Guru is divine, invisible and mysterious.
I serve at the Guru's feet, which are worshipped by all. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: gur bin avar naahee mai thaau ||

en.bdb: Without the Guru, I have no other place at all.

verse.unicode: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: anadhin japau guroo gur naau ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: Night and day, I chant the Name of Guru, Guru. ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥

transliteration.english: gur meraa giaan gur ridhai dhiaan ||

en.bdb: The Guru is my spiritual wisdom, the Guru is the meditation within my heart.
The Guru is the Lord of the World, the Primal Being, the Lord God.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਹਉ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥

transliteration.english: gur kee saran rahau kar jor ||

en.bdb: With my palms pressed together, I remain in the Guru's Sanctuary.
Without the Guru, I have no other at all. ||2||
The Guru is the boat to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
Serving the Guru, one is released from the Messenger of Death.
In the darkness, the Guru's Mantra shines forth.
With the Guru, all are saved. ||3||
The Perfect Guru is found, by great good fortune.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥

transliteration.english: gur kee sevaa dhookh na laagee ||

en.bdb: Serving the Guru, pain does not afflict anyone.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

transliteration.english: gur kaa sabadh na meTai koi ||

en.bdb: No one can erase the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Nanak is the Guru; Nanak is the Lord Himself. ||4||7||9||
